# Pagination

Links to the pages of a long list, with Bootstrap's names: the current page says so in `aria-current="page"`, a page there is none of says so in `aria-disabled`. A list that pages by "the next 50" shows only previous, next and where you are.

## Examples

A `nav` named for what it pages holds the list; each page is a link. A page there is none of — the previous one of the first page — is a link without `href` and `aria-disabled="true"`, out of the Tab order. Skip no page silently: an ellipsis stands for the pages between. Show no pagination for a single page.

```html
<nav aria-label="Pages of excursions">
	<ul class="pagination">
		<li class="page-item"><a class="page-link" href="#pagination-numbers"><i class="bi bi-chevron-left flip-rtl" aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="visually-hidden">Previous page</span></a></li>
		<li class="page-item"><a class="page-link" href="#pagination-numbers">1</a></li>
		<li class="page-item"><a class="page-link" href="#pagination-numbers" aria-current="page">2</a></li>
		<li class="page-item"><a class="page-link" href="#pagination-numbers">3</a></li>
		<li class="page-item"><span class="page-text" aria-hidden="true">…</span></li>
		<li class="page-item"><a class="page-link" href="#pagination-numbers">12</a></li>
		<li class="page-item"><a class="page-link" href="#pagination-numbers"><span class="visually-hidden">Next page</span><i class="bi bi-chevron-right flip-rtl" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></li>
	</ul>
</nav>
```

### Previous and next

A list that reads its rows page by page from where the last one ended — the fast way for a large table — knows no page numbers: it shows the rows on view and the way back and on. `page-text` holds words between the links.

```html
<nav aria-label="Pages of bookings">
	<ul class="pagination">
		<li class="page-item"><a class="page-link" href="#pagination-keyset"><i class="bi bi-chevron-left flip-rtl" aria-hidden="true"></i>Previous</a></li>
		<li class="page-item"><span class="page-text">51–100 of 1 234</span></li>
		<li class="page-item"><a class="page-link" href="#pagination-keyset">Next<i class="bi bi-chevron-right flip-rtl" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></li>
	</ul>
</nav>
```

### Sizes

`pagination-sm` and `pagination-lg` on the list.

```html
<nav aria-label="Small pages">
	<ul class="pagination pagination-sm">
		<li class="page-item"><a class="page-link" aria-disabled="true"><i class="bi bi-chevron-left flip-rtl" aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="visually-hidden">Previous page</span></a></li>
		<li class="page-item"><a class="page-link" href="#pagination-sizes" aria-current="page">1</a></li>
		<li class="page-item"><a class="page-link" href="#pagination-sizes">2</a></li>
		<li class="page-item"><a class="page-link" href="#pagination-sizes"><span class="visually-hidden">Next page</span><i class="bi bi-chevron-right flip-rtl" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></li>
	</ul>
</nav>
<nav aria-label="Large pages">
	<ul class="pagination pagination-lg">
		<li class="page-item"><a class="page-link" href="#pagination-sizes">1</a></li>
		<li class="page-item"><a class="page-link" href="#pagination-sizes" aria-current="page">2</a></li>
		<li class="page-item"><a class="page-link" href="#pagination-sizes">3</a></li>
	</ul>
</nav>
```

## States

## Keyboard and accessibility

- The `nav` has a name — "Pages of excursions" — so a screen reader lists it among the landmarks; the current page is `aria-current="page"`, read as "current page".
- An arrow-only link carries its words in `visually-hidden` text; the chevrons turn round right to left by `flip-rtl`.
- A page there is none of has no `href`, so Tab passes it, and `aria-disabled="true"` greys it.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/pagination.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/pagination.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-space-4`, `--redz-control-height`, `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-border`, `--redz-radius-8`, `--redz-bg`, `--redz-text`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-bg-hover`, `--redz-primary`, `--redz-primary-contrast`, `--redz-text-faint`, `--redz-control-height-sm`, `--redz-fs-12`, `--redz-control-height-lg`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-fs-16`.
